name: Paris Romance Tour
description: A seven day romantic escape through the heart of Paris with a private Seine dinner cruise, a sunrise visit to Montmartre and a guided evening at the Louvre after closing hours. Days are left free for patisserie hopping in Le Marais, a perfume workshop and a day trip to the gardens of Versailles. Boutique hotel stay near the Eiffel Tower is included.

name: Tokyo Cherry Blossom Trip
description: Ten days following the sakura front across Japan, beginning with hanami picnics in Ueno Park and the Meguro River in Tokyo. The route continues by bullet train to Kyoto for temple walks and a traditional tea ceremony, then to Osaka for street food tours. Accommodation mixes modern city hotels with one night in a ryokan with hot springs.

name: Bali Beach Getaway
description: An eight day beach holiday on the south coast of Bali with a seaside villa near Seminyak. Planned activities include beginner surf lessons in Canggu, sunset drinks at Uluwatu cliff temple, a snorkeling excursion to Nusa Penida and a traditional Balinese massage. Airport transfers and daily breakfast are included while the remaining time is open for relaxing.

name: New York Winter Holiday
description: Six festive days in Manhattan during the holiday season. The itinerary covers ice skating at Rockefeller Center, the window displays along Fifth Avenue, a Broadway show and a skyline view from the Top of the Rock. A guided food tour through Greenwich Village and a ferry ride past the Statue of Liberty complete the plan, with a hotel in Midtown.

name: Dubai Luxury Escape
description: Five days of premium comfort in Dubai featuring a suite overlooking the Burj Khalifa, a desert safari with a private camp dinner and a visit to the observation deck at sunset. Guests also enjoy a yacht cruise along Dubai Marina, a morning at the gold and spice souks and a spa treatment. A private driver handles every transfer for the full stay.

name: Singapore Food Adventure
description: A six day culinary journey through Singapore with guided hawker centre tastings in Maxwell and Lau Pa Sat, a chili crab cooking class and a Peranakan heritage lunch in Katong. Between meals the group explores Gardens by the Bay, the Singapore Botanic Gardens and the colorful lanes of Little India. Stay is a central hotel close to the metro.

name: London Heritage Week
description: Nine days exploring the history of London and its surroundings. Highlights include the Tower of London, the British Museum, a Thames walk from Westminster to Greenwich and an afternoon tea in Mayfair. Day trips lead to Windsor Castle, Oxford and the stone circle at Stonehenge. Evenings feature West End theatre and relaxed pub dinners, with a central hotel base in Bloomsbury.

name: Sydney Harbour Summer
description: Two weeks of southern hemisphere summer centered on Sydney Harbour. Travellers swim at Bondi and Manly, climb the Harbour Bridge at dusk and attend an evening performance at the Opera House. A coastal train journey leads to the Blue Mountains, while a short flight allows a weekend at the Great Barrier Reef. Apartment style accommodation near Circular Quay is arranged.

name: Bangkok Temples and Street Food
description: A compact five day city break in Bangkok focused on temples, markets and food. The agenda includes the Grand Palace, Wat Pho and Wat Arun, a longtail boat ride along the canals, a night market tour in Chinatown and a Thai cooking class with a local chef. Rooftop dinner views over the Chao Phraya River round off a lively stay.

name: Rome Eternal City Break
description: Seven days of ancient history, art and Italian cuisine in Rome. Skip the line entry is arranged for the Colosseum, the Roman Forum and the Vatican Museums with the Sistine Chapel. Evenings are for trattoria dinners in Trastevere, gelato walks past the Trevi Fountain and a wine tasting. A guided day trip to the ruins of Ostia Antica is included.

name: Kerala Backwaters Retreat
description: A four day slow paced retreat in Kerala centered on a private houseboat cruise through the Alleppey backwaters. The trip features home cooked seafood meals, village walks, a coconut craft demonstration and an Ayurvedic massage session. A short drive from Kochi brings travellers to tea plantations in Munnar for misty mornings, cool air and a final night at a hillside resort.

name: Grand European Rail Odyssey
description: Three weeks crossing Europe by rail, starting in Berlin and continuing through Prague, Vienna, Venice, Zurich and Paris. First class seats and flexible connections allow time for museum visits, mountain lake walks in Switzerland and evening opera in Vienna. Hotels are centrally placed near each main station, and a rail pass covers every scheduled leg of the route.

name: Bali Wellness and Yoga Retreat
description: Twelve days of restoration in the rice terraces around Ubud. Daily schedules include sunrise yoga, guided meditation, plant based meals and a weekly cleansing ritual at a holy water temple. Free afternoons allow cycling through villages, cooking with local families and visits to craft workshops. Accommodation is a quiet bamboo villa with a garden pool and in-house spa.

name: Singapore Business and Leisure Combo
description: Eight days combining client meetings in the Marina Bay financial district with time to enjoy the city. The plan includes a hotel with a business lounge and fast connectivity, plus an evening river cruise, a visit to the National Gallery and a night safari. Weekend free time covers Sentosa island, beach clubs and a relaxed brunch in Tiong Bahru.

name: Tokyo Autumn Foliage Escape
description: A short three day visit to Tokyo timed for the peak of autumn colors. Travellers stroll through the ginkgo avenue of Meiji Jingu Gaien, the maple trees of Rikugien Garden and the hillside paths near Mount Takao. The trip also leaves room for ramen tasting in Shinjuku, shopping in Ginza and a final evening at the teamLab digital art museum.
